dogecoin.text: Wasn’t expecting to wake up to the founder and fanatical followers of dogecoin swamping my mentions. But that’s what makes this website so magical ✨

A very good thread here by the co-creator of Dogecoin. But also, yet another person who—after years of being a booster, of studying, of soul searching—finally reached the conclusion that many of us have long known to be true. I promise it's way easier to listen from the start.
